dependencies.name: hyperliquid-python-sdk
allowed_components: public and account read data types
forbidden_components: Hermes or client access to Exchange order methods
treating WebSocket callbacks as authoritative trading state
security_boundaries: SDK is confined to the Hyperliquid adapter layer
no signer or wallet in the current phase
unknown execution state fails closed
reconnect must enter STALE or RECONCILING until REST reconciliation succeeds
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Pin an official release and resolved commit; review Info, Exchange, WebSocket, precision and signing diffs; run read-only and disconnect/reorder/duplicate/gap reconciliation tests. An upgrade never authorizes write access.

dependencies.name: lightweight-charts
forbidden_components: deriving server order state from chart state
security_boundaries: chart is presentation only
TradingView NOTICE attribution and user-visible link are mandatory
tslib BSD Zero Clause attribution is preserved
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Pin the exact npm version and lockfile integrity; diff LICENSE, NOTICE, tslib attribution and rendering/plugin APIs; run browser and Tauri visual/interaction regression.

dependencies.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
forbidden_components: signing, ordering, transfer, withdrawal, SQL or risk-policy tools
security_boundaries: dedicated unprivileged identity in a container or equivalent OS sandbox
read-only root filesystem and minimal mounts
default-deny egress limited to approved model endpoints and the controlled Go MCP gateway
no host shell, SSH, Docker socket, wallet, signer or exchange executor route
server injects identity and Go validates schema, confirmation, risk and state transitions
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Pin tag, resolved commit and Python lockfile; default-deny every new tool or network endpoint; compare persistence and migration behavior; rerun MCP inventory, prompt-injection and isolation-escape tests.

dependencies.name: pgx-v5
security_boundaries: database access exists only in server-owned services
credentials are injected outside source and logs
Go 1.23 compatibility is mandatory
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Keep major version v5. Raise the Go baseline in a separate change before considering v5.8 or newer; then run migration, concurrency, disconnect and recovery tests.

dependencies.name: sqlc
allowed_components: Go query code generation in development and CI
security_boundaries: official release artifact only
verify the SHA-256 digest published in GitHub Release metadata
do not build from source with the current Go 1.23 toolchain
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Pin the official release asset and digest, pin sqlc configuration schema, review deterministic generated diffs, and run database integration tests.

dependencies.name: nats.go
forbidden_components: authoritative trading state in the message bus
security_boundaries: internal network only
server-authored state remains authoritative
disconnect and reconnect are explicit service states
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Review reconnect, drain and JetStream ack/redelivery semantics and run disconnect, duplicate, reorder and consumer-restart tests. Raise Go separately before v1.49 or newer.

dependencies.name: chi
security_boundaries: authentication and authorization remain explicit server middleware
request sizes and timeouts are bounded
debug routes are not exposed
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Keep major version v5 and recheck middleware order, route matching, security headers, request-size limits and timeout tests.

dependencies.name: opentelemetry-go
forbidden_components: Hermes prompts or personal trade rationales
security_boundaries: attribute allowlist and redaction
explicit internal exporter endpoint
telemetry is non-authoritative and fail-open relative to service availability
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Audit the attribute allowlist and exporter endpoint, then test sampling, backpressure, shutdown and redaction. Raise Go separately before v1.39 or newer.

dependencies.name: testcontainers-go
allowed_components: fault-injection containers with pinned image digests
forbidden_components: interpreting test success as live-trading authorization
security_boundaries: development and CI only
pinned image digests
isolated networks and deterministic cleanup
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Review Docker API and cleanup changes, lock test image digests, and validate failed-run cleanup and parallel isolation. Raise Go separately before v0.39 or newer.

dependencies.name: Tauri
forbidden_components: default shell, process, filesystem, global HTTP or updater powers
remote content with local command rights
security_boundaries: capability allowlist and restrictive CSP
validated command arguments
no signer or wallet material in WebView or sidecar
signed and pinned update channel when updates are later enabled
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Keep Rust crates and JavaScript packages on the same exact release; diff capabilities and CSP; test command validation, path traversal, remote content, update signatures and desktop UI.

dependencies.name: Hummingbot
forbidden_components: copying authentication, signing, ordering, fee, builder, reconnect or strategy code
using Hummingbot state as authoritative state
copying default builder address, fee or injection behavior
security_boundaries: clean implementation against Hyperliquid official sources
no Hummingbot builder field or fee
any future builder support requires a separate explicit product, legal, security and user-consent review
dependencies.upgrade_policy: No runtime upgrade path. Refresh the reference snapshot only in a separate evidence task.

dependencies.name: CCXT
forbidden_components: dynamic loading of bundled exchange implementations
security_boundaries: Hyperliquid official API and SDK remain primary
single-exchange BTC, ETH and SOL perpetual scope is preserved
dependencies.upgrade_policy: No runtime upgrade path. Refresh the reference snapshot only in a separate evidence task.

dependencies.name: Freqtrade
security_boundaries: generic concepts must be independently derived from protocol or official API sources
retain clean-implementation evidence
dependencies.upgrade_policy: Not applicable. The project is not eligible for dependency upgrade or code import.
